provenancePolicy: Source commits identify inspected checkout baselines. Files marked workingTreeChange include pre-existing or current uncommitted implementation. A release owner must review this catalog and bind it to deployed image digests before treating it as deployed behavior.

steps.expected: An authorized driver start request creates session intent; payment confirmation, tariff and subscription snapshots and remote-start acceptance are separate milestones.
steps.interpretation: A remote-start acceptance does not prove physical charging started.

steps.expected: Read persisted authorization amount, currency, status, expiry and release timestamps.
steps.interpretation: Authorization is not capture or proof of the bank's current blocked balance. Diagnostic reads must not poll or mutate provider state.

steps.expected: Correlate persisted lifecycle events and first/last meter sample with charger transaction evidence.
steps.interpretation: Sample-row count is not OCPP message count. Connector/time-window correlation is weaker than exact transaction correlation. Missing telemetry alone does not prove charging stopped.

steps.expected: Compare remote-stop request, stop acknowledgment, actual stoppedAt and any unplug requirement.
steps.interpretation: State alone does not establish that a session is stuck. Identify missing milestone and elapsed time; mark unavailable thresholds and correlation gaps.

steps.expected: Use the persisted tariff and subscription snapshot and backend billing evidence for energy/time/flat/idle fees, caps, quota coverage and discount.
steps.interpretation: Do not recalculate an authoritative bill with a language model. Report backend calculation, units, currency and any reconciliation gap.

steps.expected: Inspect latest payment settlement attempt and release evidence independently from terminal session status.
steps.interpretation: COMPLETED or BILLED does not alone prove payment capture. No refund, retry, stop, release or billing correction is performed by these tools.

organizationAuthority: The authorized session's stored enterpriseId/networkId/locationId/chargerId establish the selected session context. Requester tenant is a separate identity claim. Kubernetes namespace/labels do not prove organization ownership.

routes.authorization: SYSTEM_ADMIN or SUPPORT plus signed gateway scope and session ownership access
Same scoped session route; only curated organizationContext returned
Signed SYSTEM_ADMIN or SUPPORT; namespace-scoped Kubernetes read account for collection

gaps: This flow catalog is reviewed source knowledge, not learned customer memory or model fine-tuning.
No production deployment manifests or live trace correlations were verified during implementation.
Repository inventory is discovery metadata; it is not permission to invoke every API.
